description: This file defines the Spinner class for creating and managing animated spinner objects with customizable frames, styles, and update behavior. It includes methods for rendering, updating, and measuring spinners and references internal spinner definitions and other rich components.

classes.name: Spinner
classes.description: A class representing a spinner animation with methods to render, update, and measure spinner frames, supporting customization of style, speed, and accompanying text.

methods.name: None __init__( self, name: str, text: "RenderableType" = "", *, style: Optional["StyleType"] = None, speed: float = 1.0, )
methods.description: Initializes a Spinner instance with a name, optional text, style, and speed, performing validation against predefined spinner frames.

methods.name: "RenderResult" __rich_console__( self, console: "Console", options: "ConsoleOptions" )
methods.description: Generates the render output for the spinner at a given console time.

methods.name: Measurement __rich_measure__( self, console: "Console", options: "ConsoleOptions" )
methods.description: Returns the measurement of the spinner's size for layout purposes.

methods.name: "RenderableType" render(self, time: float)
methods.description: Creates and returns the visual representation of the spinner at a specific time, including handling of associated text and layout.

methods.name: None update( self, *, text: "RenderableType" = "", style: Optional["StyleType"] = None, speed: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Allows changing the spinner's text, style, and speed after creation.
